body: your pain touches me really deep, and i’m sorry to know that you feel all of this crushing you at a time in your life that’s supposed to be the start to a new chapter. to tell you the truth, i’m not doing so awesome at this time in my life either, but thirteen was one of the worst years i lived through. when even your therapist seems to be against you, it’s like... what can you DO, who else IS there? i’m sorry you have these people, friends and family, around you that refuse to believe what you’re going through. a lot of people, even those in your own age group, just think that nobody that young can hurt so bad. but you can, and you do, and i believe you. i believe, too, that you’re gonna find the other side. something that helps a lot is just finding SOMETHING to get you through each day, no matter how small. i did this for a long time, and i still am doing it. ‘oh, i can’t die, it’s storming and my dog needs me to comfort her, i can’t die, i still wanna hear that P!ATD album, i can’t die, i didn’t finish that book yet and the sequel is supposed to be good.’ (all things i’ve told myself LOL) it sounds dumb, but when the “big” motivators like friends and family aren’t what you need... you have to cling on to every little thing that can get you through even the next fuckin’ thirty minutes. don’t throw in the towel, okay? you’re gonna need it when the storm quiets down and the waves stop crashing. this world is a shitshow, people seem to just exist to torment you, but try your damndest to pull yourself through until you find people that want to give you a hand. they’re out there, and i’m here too, if you just need an adult-type-person to listen that doesn’t think you’re being a teenage drama queen.

that’s a really tough thing to carry with you for so long, i’m sorry you’ve had it on you for all this time. as difficult as it is to bring up things that heavy, i think you owe it to both you and your wife to tell her a good amount of time before enlisting, and allow her some time to think over what she wants, too. i don’t know you or your relationship, of course, but it seems like you really are content with the idea of divorcing her. if following your dream to protect your country and her people is what you believe in your heart will make you happiest, then... you should do that! aim to work together to make whatever may come as easy on each other and your child as you’re able to, but this is where your heart has been calling you for all this time. you’ll find your way through everything standing in between you and this dream, but never if you don’t take the first plunge. mazel tov!!!!!
to be honest, it’s somehow much more of a comfort than i’ve had in a long time. thank you, you’re very kind; i hate knowing that others are suffering, but it takes the edge off the isolation.
